description: Market sync manifest — 34 Soulstice MarketItems with full data for import into the Geode Inn app. Match by name field and update all other fields.

items.name: Garnet, gold and spinel earrings
items.realName: Garnet, gold and spinel earrings
items.realDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring garnet, gold, and spinel.
items.gameDescription: Earrings of garnet, gold, and spinel. The deep red, the metal, and the dark. Wearing them in the Undercity reveals hidden passages in the bone rooms.
items.loreConnection: Garnet (Stone entity), Spinel (Stone entity). Connected to the Undercity and Klimt's Death and Life aesthetic.

items.name: Silver, black onyx, and pietersite earrings
items.realName: Silver, black onyx, and pietersite earrings
items.realDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring silver, black onyx, and pietersite.
items.gameDescription: Earrings of silver, black onyx, and pietersite. The silver, the shield, and the storm. Wearing them in the Inn silences ambient noise and sharpens NPC dialogue.
items.loreConnection: Black Onyx (Stone entity, facetable despite opacity), Pietersite (Stone entity). Connected to the acoustic architecture and dialogue systems.

items.name: Celtic woven leather in black
items.realName: Celtic woven leather in black
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather in black.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic weave in black leather. The pattern is for those who walk in shadow. The knot holds in the dark.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — shadow variant. Connected to the Shadow Inn (84Hz).

items.name: Celtic leather in gray and brown
items.realName: Celtic leather in gray and brown
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather in gray and brown.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot in gray and brown, the colors of river stones. The pattern flows between earth and ash.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Triple moon with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon
items.realName: Triple moon with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon
items.realDescription: Triple moon pendant with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon.
items.gameDescription: A triple moon pendant with smoky quartz, agate, and garnet on a silk ribbon. The triple moon is the Inn's symbol for the triad of creators. Wearing it reveals hidden NPC dialogue about the Inn's founding.
items.loreConnection: Smoky Quartz (Stone entity), Agate (Stone entity), Garnet (Stone entity). The triple moon connects to the Inn's three creators. Silk ribbon = the thread of the narrative.

items.name: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings (variant)
items.realName: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings
items.realDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring Baltic amber, amethyst, and silver.
items.gameDescription: Earrings of Baltic amber, amethyst, and silver. The amber holds ancient light, the amethyst holds calm, the silver holds the shape. The fire grows warmer when these are near.
items.loreConnection: Baltic Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Hearth and fire mechanics.

items.name: Celtic leather in light brown
items.realName: Celtic leather in light brown
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather in light brown.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot in light brown leather, the color of sandstone in morning light. The pattern is warm.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Celtic leather bracelet in gray and brown
items.realName: Celtic leather bracelet in gray and brown
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather bracelet in gray and brown.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot bracelet in gray and brown. The colors of weathered stone and riverbank earth.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Viking earrings
items.realName: Viking earrings
items.realDescription: Handcrafted Viking-style earrings.
items.gameDescription: Viking earrings. The design is older than the Inn. The metal remembers the cold of the north. Wearing them in the Norse zone unlocks hidden rune dialogue.
items.loreConnection: Connected to the Norse zone (Book of Kells artist assignment) and Viking mythology in the Lore entity.

items.name: Celtic leather in grays and browns
items.realName: Celtic leather in grays and browns
items.realDescription: Handmade Celtic leatherwork in grays and browns. Masterwork tier.
items.gameDescription: A masterwork of Celtic leatherwork in grays and browns. The colors of stone and earth and patience. The most complex pattern in the collection.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — masterwork tier. Connected to the Inn's crafting system and the Knotwork game.

items.name: Aquamarine, Carnelian and Onyx
items.realName: Aquamarine, Carnelian and Onyx
items.realDescription: Handcrafted piece featuring aquamarine, carnelian, and onyx.
items.gameDescription: A piece with aquamarine, carnelian, and onyx. The sea, the fire, and the shield. Wearing it in the Tidal Caves reveals the Selkie's workshop.
items.loreConnection: Aquamarine (Stone entity), Carnelian (Stone entity), Onyx (Stone entity). Connected to the Water Zone and the Selkie questline.

items.name: Celtic leather love knot in green and brown
items.realName: Celtic leather love knot in green and brown
items.realDescription: Celtic leather love knot in green and brown.
items.gameDescription: A love knot in green and brown leather. The colors of growth and earth. The knot that does not end.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — love knot variant. Connected to the Inn's warmth mechanics.

items.name: Celtic leather bracelet in green
items.realName: Celtic leather bracelet in green
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather bracelet in green.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot bracelet in green leather. The color of the canopy. The pattern grows.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — canopy variant. Connected to the Canopy Zone (42Hz grow).

items.name: Bloodlust
items.realName: Bloodlust
items.realDescription: Handcrafted piece called Bloodlust. Deep red and dark stones.
items.gameDescription: A piece called Bloodlust. The name is honest. The stones are deep red and dark. Wearing it in the Shadow Inn increases combat frequency but also reveals hidden truth in Whisper Layer messages.
items.loreConnection: Connected to the Shadow Inn (84Hz) and the combat/truth duality. The name reflects the Inn's honesty about its darker zones.

items.name: LIMITED EDITION 5 Strand Gemstone Necklace
items.realName: LIMITED EDITION 5 Strand Gemstone Necklace
items.realDescription: Limited edition 5-strand gemstone necklace. The most complex piece in the Soulstice collection.
items.gameDescription: A limited edition 5-strand gemstone necklace. The most complex piece in the collection. Five strands of stones, each representing a level of the Inn: Cosmology, Main Floor, Staircase, Catacombs, and the Final Room. Wearing all five at once is said to let you hear the 42Hz Song with your own ears.
items.loreConnection: Connected to all five levels of the Inn. The 5-strand design mirrors the Inn's vertical descent structure. This is the legendary piece of the collection.

items.name: Celtic leather in black and green
items.realName: Celtic leather in black and green
items.realDescription: 16 strands of leather in a Celtic knot pattern. Woven pattern is 16 inches with 7-inch deer hide leather extender cords. Can be worn around the neck, hat, or brow.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot woven from 16 strands of leather, black and green as the moss on standing stones. The pattern has no beginning and no end. The Inn recognizes the knotwork as its own.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork is the ambient texture of the Inn. This piece is the craft made physical.

items.name: Leather Celtic bracelet in blacks, blues, and browns
items.realName: Leather Celtic bracelet in blacks, blues, and browns
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather bracelet in blacks, blues, and browns.
items.gameDescription: A bracelet of woven leather, the colors of deep water and dark earth. The knotwork holds the wrist the way the Inn holds its stones.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork bracelet — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Leather Celtic necklace in blacks, blues, and browns
items.realName: Leather Celtic necklace in blacks, blues, and browns
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather necklace in blacks, blues, and browns.
items.gameDescription: A necklace of woven leather, the colors of twilight over standing stones. The pattern continues around the neck and back into itself.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork necklace — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Celtic leather in brown, black, and green
items.realName: Celtic leather in brown, black, and green
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather piece in brown, black, and green.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot in the colors of forest floor and stone. The pattern is ancient. The leather is patient.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Celtic leather bracelet in brown
items.realName: Celtic leather bracelet in brown
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather bracelet in brown.
items.gameDescription: A simple Celtic knot bracelet, brown as the earth beneath the Inn. The first knot a weaver learns.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — entry-level craft of the Inn.

items.name: Celtic leather in green and black
items.realName: Celtic leather in green and black
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather in green and black.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot in green and black, the colors of moss on volcanic stone. The pattern remembers the forests that grew before the Inn was built.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Peridot, amber and amethyst earrings
items.realName: Peridot, amber and amethyst earrings
items.realDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring peridot, amber, and amethyst stones.
items.gameDescription: Earrings of peridot, amber, and amethyst — green, gold, and purple. The colors of a sunset seen through the canopy. Wearing them in the Inn sharpens hearing in the Fae Kingdom.
items.loreConnection: Peridot (Stone entity), Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Canopy Zone and Fae Kingdom acoustics.

items.name: Celtic leather love knot bracelet in green
items.realName: Celtic leather love knot bracelet in green
items.realDescription: Celtic leather love knot bracelet in green.
items.gameDescription: A love knot in green leather. The knot that has no end because love was never supposed to. The Inn keeps one above the hearth.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — love knot variant. Connected to the Inn's warmth mechanics.

items.name: Celtic leather bracelet in black and green
items.realName: Celtic leather bracelet in black and green
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather bracelet in black and green.
items.gameDescription: A bracelet of black and green leather, woven in the Celtic pattern. The colors of shadow and growth.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Celtic leather in black and browns
items.realName: Celtic leather in black and browns
items.realDescription: Celtic woven leather in black and browns.
items.gameDescription: A Celtic knot in black and brown, the colors of charred wood and earth. The pattern holds.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — the Inn's ambient texture made wearable.

items.name: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings
items.realName: Baltic amber, amethyst and silver earrings
items.realDescription: Handcrafted earrings featuring Baltic amber, amethyst, and silver.
items.gameDescription: Earrings of Baltic amber and amethyst in silver. The amber holds the light of a sun that shone before the Inn. Wearing them near the fire makes the flame brighter.
items.loreConnection: Baltic Amber (Stone entity), Amethyst (Stone entity). Connected to the Hearth and fire mechanics.

items.name: Sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops
items.realName: Sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz drops
items.realDescription: Drop earrings featuring sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz.
items.gameDescription: Drops of sunstone, garnet, and London blue topaz. The sun, the blood, and the deep water. Wearing them in the Water Zone reveals hidden tide pools.
items.loreConnection: Sunstone (Stone entity), Garnet (Stone entity), London Blue Topaz (Stone entity). Connected to the Water Zone and tidal mechanics.

items.name: Celtic love weaving in black
items.realName: Celtic love weaving in black
items.realDescription: Celtic love weaving in black leather with woven cord.
items.gameDescription: A love weaving in black leather. The pattern is for those who love in shadow. The Inn does not judge.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — love weaving variant. Connected to the Shadow Inn (84Hz).

items.name: Handmade Celtic leatherwork in gray, green, and black
items.realName: Handmade Celtic leatherwork in gray, green, and black
items.realDescription: Handmade Celtic leatherwork in gray, green, and black. Multiple options available.
items.gameDescription: A masterwork of Celtic leatherwork in gray, green, and black. The three colors of the Inn's stone. This is the knot that takes longest to learn.
items.loreConnection: Celtic knotwork — masterwork tier. Connected to the Inn's crafting system.

items.name: Leather and skulls
items.realName: Leather and skulls
items.realDescription: Leather necklace featuring small skull charms on braided cord.
items.gameDescription: A necklace of leather and skulls. The Inn's catacombs remember every traveler. This piece is for those who are not afraid of what stays.
items.loreConnection: Connected to the Catacombs zone and the Inn's death/remembrance themes.

items.name: The Bluestone Key
items.realName: Preseli Bluestone Pendant
items.realDescription: Authentic Preseli Blue Stone (dolerite) from the Preseli Hills, Wales — the same source as the Stonehenge bluestones. Polished cabochon in sterling silver.
items.gameDescription: A piece of Preseli Blue Stone, the bluestone that walks. The stone that was carried 140 miles from the Preseli Hills to Stonehenge, on human backs, before wheels were invented. Why? Because the stones asked to go. The Standing Stones game unlocks when you hold this. The portal opens. The Fae Kingdom is listening.
items.loreConnection: Preseli Blue Stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Standing Stones game (Phase 1 Tetris) and the Fae Kingdom portal system. The bluestone is the physical key to the game's biggest zone.

items.name: The Truth-Teller's Ring
items.realName: Malachite Ring in Copper
items.realDescription: Natural malachite ring set in copper. Each piece is unique due to the natural banding patterns of the stone.
items.gameDescription: A ring of malachite, the copper stone, green as the earth's own blood. The Crone once said that malachite is the only stone that honest people should wear, because it changes color when it touches a lie. She was not making a joke. She was making a warning.
items.loreConnection: Malachite stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Crone's character and her precision-without-cushioning philosophy.

items.name: The Aurora Pendant
items.realName: Labradorite Pendant Sterling Silver
items.realDescription: Handcrafted labradorite pendant in sterling silver. Each piece features natural blue flash labradorite sourced from Labrador, Canada.
items.gameDescription: A pendant of labradorite, the Aurora Stone, carried south from Labrador by a river that no longer exists. The light trapped inside shifts when you breathe near it — blue, green, gold — the colors of a sky that has not yet decided what it wants to be. The Catalyst grows these in her garden, in the shade, where the moon does most of the watering.
items.loreConnection: Labradorite stone from the Stone entity. Connected to the Catalyst's garden and the Fae Kingdom portal system. The stone's color-shift mirrors the Fae realm's shifting geography.

items.name: The Cat's Eye of Bastet
items.realName: Cat's Eye Chrysoberyl Pendant
items.realDescription: Genuine cat's eye chrysoberyl cabochon set in sterling silver. Displays sharp chatoyancy (cat's eye effect) under direct light.
items.gameDescription: A chrysoberyl cat's eye, set in silver, watching. Bastet's stone. The eye that follows you is not watching you — it is watching what watches you. The cats in the Egyptian zone stare at it. They are not afraid. They are checking that it is doing its job.
items.loreConnection: Cat's Eye Chrysoberyl from the Stone entity. Connected to Bastet's Herding game and the Egyptian zone's cat mechanics.
